title: The government loses a confidence vote
summary: The government tabled a motion of confidence over questions about a company owned by the prime minister's family and lost it on 11 March 2025, the PS and Chega voting against. The motion was its own: the opposition had put down censure motions, and the government chose to ask the chamber to confirm it instead.
